response.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings WHERE points >= 6.0 GROUP BY raceId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg_wins FROM per_race) SELECT p.raceId, p.avg_points, p.avg_wins, p.avg_wins - o.overall_avg_wins AS diff FROM per_race p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff IS NULL, diff DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The 6.0 threshold is applied to each constructorStandings row's own season-to-date points before grouping, so races with no qualifying rows do not appear.

NULL wins values are excluded from each race's average wins (SQL AVG behavior). A race whose qualifying rows all have NULL wins has a NULL average and is left out of the overall average but still listed, with a NULL difference sorted last.
The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-race average wins, with NULL per-race values ignored. If that mean is NULL, no rows are returned.
Ties in the difference are not ordered by any secondary key, so their relative order is unspecified.
